instruction: Search for Batman toys for children and sort the results from lowest to highest price.

metadata.explanation: Task variation searches for Batman toys instead of Spider-Man toys, maintaining the same pattern: search for a superhero toy category for kids and sort by price low to high. Uses existing evaluator functions (check_direct_json_object and get_active_tab_html_parse) to verify breadcrumbs and URL parameters on Kohl's website.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: Batman search, toys category, kids filter, and price low-to-high sorting
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse with category 'class&url') extracts breadcrumb navigation, dropdown selector state, and URL parameters
Metric logic (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares expected boolean values against getter results
Multiple verification methods provide robustness: breadcrumb classes (pmpSearch_breadcrumb, sbSelector), URL parameter checks (Batman/batman, Toys, Kids, S=4), and multichoice mappings
Expected values are semantically correct: batman=true, toys=true, kids=true, price low-high=true, is_other_exist=false
Case handling is correct: getter converts to lowercase, expected uses lowercase keys
Evaluator can successfully verify task completion at runtime
